title: Learning Heterogeneous Reasoning in Large Language Models: From Mode Compatibility to Local Bottlenecks
abstract: arXiv:2611.30281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training large language models routinely pools reasoning trajectories from diverse teachers or algorithms, yet it remains unclear whether standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can learn such heterogeneous strategies without explicit mode conditioning. We study the learnability and local bottlenecks of heterogeneous reasoning through a formal mixture formulation and controlled experiments. We first formalize the representational compatibility of the optimal autoregressive model with latent reasoning mixtures: the target next-token distribution weights modes by their prefix posteriors and concentrates on a single mode once alternative modes assign negligible likelihood to the prefix. In a verifiable symbolic graph-search environment with paired breadth-first and depth-first search trajectories, no consistent disadvantage is observed for unlabeled mixed SFT relative to homogeneous or labeled baselines under matched token budgets while

translated_title: 大语言模型中的异构推理学习：从模式兼容性到局部瓶颈
translated_abstract: 对大语言模型进行后训练时，通常会汇集来自不同教师模型或算法的推理轨迹，然而目前尚不清楚标准的监督微调（SFT）能否在缺乏显式模式条件化的情况下学习此类异构策略。我们通过形式化的混合建模与受控实验，研究异构推理的可学习性及其局部瓶颈。我们首先形式化了最优自回归模型与潜在推理混合之间的表征兼容性：目标的下一个词元分布按各模式的前缀后验概率进行加权，且一旦其他模式对前缀赋予的概率可忽略不计，该分布便会集中于单一模式。在一个配有成对广度优先与深度优先搜索轨迹的可验证符号图搜索环境中，在匹配的词元预算下，未标注的混合SFT相对于同质或有标注的基线并未表现出一致的劣势……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文从理论上证明了最优自回归模型可表征潜在推理策略混合，并通过受控实验表明标准SFT无需显式模式标注即可学习异构推理策略，同时揭示了其中的局部瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically proves that the optimal autoregressive model can represent latent mixtures of reasoning strategies, and through controlled experiments shows that standard SFT can learn heterogeneous reasoning strategies without explicit mode conditioning, while identifying the associated local bottlenecks.
